oil.when: 2013–2016 using the Driver Information Center controls on the right of the steering wheel
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition on, use the DIC controls on the right side of the steering wheel to bring up REMAINING OIL LIFE in the instrument cluster.
Press and hold SEL for a few seconds until the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message clears and oil life shows 100%.
oil.note: Checked in the 2013, 2014 and 2016 owner's manuals. The 2016 manual also lists an accelerator pedal method: ignition on with the engine off, then press the pedal fully to the floor three times within five seconds.

tpms.when: 2013–2016 after the low tire pressure light came on
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label in the driver's door opening.
There is no reset button: the low tire pressure light stays on until the pressures are corrected, then goes out.
Check that the light has gone out. If it stays on, recheck all four tires with a gauge and have the system checked if they are correct.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2013 and 2016 owner's manuals. The light can come on at the first start on a cold morning and go out as you drive; that is an early sign the tires need air. If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that inflating the tires will not clear.

notes: The oil life system does not reset itself after an oil change, so reset it every time, and only after the oil has actually been changed.
